steps.title: Point at the arrow
steps.say: This green arrow shows the demand curve moving to the right, from D1 to D2. It means that at every price, buyers now want more.

ops.text: Arrow = the whole demand curve shifts right

steps.title: Compare the two curves
steps.say: Look at one price level. On D1 buyers want the quantity at the old curve, but on D2 they want more at that same price.

steps.title: Why it matters
steps.say: With more demand but the same supply, buyers compete for the goods, and the price is pushed up. That is why the arrow leads to a higher price.
